answer: The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, clawed back after a replayed submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The pearl of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Work waits on the falcon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the wharf of the next round.
